ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the fight undone

plain.li: Dreamt the fight with {OTHER_nameDef} again, but this time we both stopped before the first blow and just stood there.
In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} and I were fighting with pillows, and neither of us could remember what about.
Last night I dreamt I'd said sorry to {OTHER_nameDef} first. I think I did, actually.
[lowtech] Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I buried a hatchet out past the fields, a real one, and marked the spot with a stone.

warm.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were laughing about the fight with everyone at the table. It felt like a long time ago.

blunt.li: Fight dream. We shook hands at the end of it. Fine by me.

cheerful.li: In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} and I fought a duel with soup ladles, and called it a draw.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the fight went the other way, and we never spoke again. Then I woke and remembered we did.

cold.li: I went over the fight with {OTHER_nameDef} in my sleep. It was a waste of both our energy.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of being laughed at

plain.li: Dreamt I walked into the dining room and everyone stopped talking, and then {OTHER_nameDef} started to laugh.
In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} kept telling the joke about me, and every time it was longer and everyone laughed louder.
Last night I dreamt my own name had turned into a joke, and I was the only one who didn't get it.
Dreamt I was standing in front of the whole colony and couldn't remember why, and {OTHER_nameDef} was grinning.

warm.li: In the dream I laughed along with {OTHER_nameDef}, and it didn't hurt. I'd like that to be true.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} laughing, all night, in my head. Enough.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I told a joke about {OTHER_nameDef} and it was so good the walls laughed. Small revenge.

gloomy.li: In my dream they were all laughing, and they'd always been laughing, and I'd only just noticed.

cold.li: Dreamt of {OTHER_nameDef}'s joke. I've decided it wasn't funny, asleep or awake.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the fine piece

plain.li: Dreamt I was making the piece again, and this time my hands knew every step before I did.
In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} held up what I'd made, and the whole room went quiet looking at it.
Last night I dreamt of a bench as long as a road, and everything I made on it came out right.
[child] I dreamt I made something so good it got its own name, and it was my name.

warm.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} said it was good again, and I believed it a bit more the second time.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the work. Good work. That's all.

cheerful.li: In my dream traders came from three worlds away just to look at what I'd made.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I could never make anything that good again. I'm going to try today anyway.

cold.li: I went over the piece in my sleep and found two things I'd do differently.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the other's piece

plain.li: Dreamt everything I made turned to sawdust in my hands, while {OTHER_nameDef}'s pieces stood all round the walls.
In the dream I kept trying to show my work to someone, and they kept walking past me to look at {OTHER_nameDef}'s.
Last night I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef}'s piece was on my shelf, and I couldn't make myself give it back.

warm.li: Dreamt I told {OTHER_nameDef} the piece was good. Maybe I should, awake.

blunt.li: Their piece, in my sleep. I'll make a better one.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I made one twice the size of {OTHER_nameDef}'s and it fell on my foot. Fair enough.

gloomy.li: In my dream nobody had ever looked at anything I made, and nobody ever would.

cold.li: I dreamt about the flaws in {OTHER_nameDef}'s piece. There are several.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the one we lost

plain.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were walking somewhere with the one we lost between us, and nobody said a word.
In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} kept saying the name of the dead, softly, so I wouldn't forget it.
Last night the one we buried came and sat at the end of my bed, and said {OTHER_nameDef} was right.
[lowtech] Dreamt the grave was a garden, and {OTHER_nameDef} was watering it.

warm.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was holding my hand at the grave. I woke and felt less alone.

blunt.li: Dreamt of the dead. {OTHER_nameDef} was there. It helped.

cheerful.li: In the dream the dead were telling {OTHER_nameDef} and me off for moping. That sounds like them.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I went looking for the one we lost, and found only {OTHER_nameDef}, looking too.

cold.li: The dead were in my dream. So was {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm sleeping badly.

plain.li: Dreamt I was back in the fight, going out for {OTHER_nameDef}, and this time I wasn't frightened at all.
In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} kept handing me things, a cup, a coat, a whole house, and saying it was owed.
Last night I dreamt it was {OTHER_nameDef} who came for me, and we both laughed about it being the wrong way round.

warm.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were old, still looking out for each other. I liked that one.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the fight. We both came out of it. Good.

cheerful.li: In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} paid me back in pies, hundreds of them, and I ate every one.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I didn't reach {OTHER_nameDef} in time. I'm glad I did, in the real one.

cold.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} kept a ledger of what we owe each other. In the dream the columns balanced.

plain.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were still at the work, racing, and the job never got any smaller.
In the dream I finally beat {OTHER_nameDef}, and there was nobody there to see it.
Last night I dreamt the work turned into a road, and {OTHER_nameDef} and I ran down it until morning.

warm.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I stopped racing and finished the job together. Strange dream.

blunt.li: Dreamt I won. Woke up tired.

cheerful.li: In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} and I raced so fast we went right through the wall and kept going.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I lost to {OTHER_nameDef} again and again, and everyone kept count.

cold.li: I worked through the job in my sleep. My pace was better than {OTHER_nameDef}'s.

plain.li: Dreamt the snow was up to the roofs and {OTHER_nameDef} and I dug tunnels through it all night.
In the dream every snowball I threw at {OTHER_nameDef} turned into a bird and flew off.
Last night I dreamt of a snow fort as big as the colony, with {OTHER_nameDef} holding the other side.
[child] I dreamt it snowed forever and nobody had to do chores, ever.

warm.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were lying in the snow making shapes, and we didn't feel the cold at all.

blunt.li: Snowball dream. I won that one.

cheerful.li: In my dream I finally got {OTHER_nameDef} right down the back of the neck, and the whole sky cheered.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the snow melted before I could throw a single one.

cold.li: I dreamt about the angle I should have thrown at. I'll remember it.

plain.li: Dreamt it was raining indoors, and {OTHER_nameDef} and I just sat there in it, eating supper.
In the dream the rain never stopped, and {OTHER_nameDef} and I kept saying it would any minute now.
Last night I dreamt the rain was warm as a bath, and nobody wanted to go inside.

warm.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} held something over my head in the rain, and for once it worked.

blunt.li: Rain dream. Woke up checking my blanket was dry.

cheerful.li: In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} and I danced in the rain, badly, and the frogs clapped.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the rain washed the whole colony away, and only {OTHER_nameDef} and I were left, soaked.

cold.li: Dreamt about the rain. We should have gone in sooner.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the one left behind

plain.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was waiting at the edge of the fields, the way {OTHER_pronoun} used to, and I couldn't get any closer.
In the dream the two colonies were one again, and {OTHER_nameDef} was at the table as if nothing had changed.
Last night I dreamt I walked all the way back to the old home in one night, just to tell {OTHER_nameDef} something.
[lowtech] Dreamt I sent {OTHER_nameDef} a message tied to a bird, and the bird came back with an answer I couldn't read.

warm.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} came to visit, and stayed for supper, and it was like no time had passed.

cheerful.li: In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} turned up at the gate with a cart full of everything we forgot to bring.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I went back and {OTHER_nameDef} didn't know who I was.

cold.li: Dreamt of the old colony. {OTHER_nameDef} is managing without me, I expect.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the old home

plain.li: Dreamt I was back at the old colony and my room had been given to someone else.
In the dream I kept walking toward the old home, and the road kept bending away from it.
Last night I dreamt I'd never left, and woke up in a bed I didn't know.
[lowtech] Dreamt the old walls were calling me back, in a voice like the wind in the smoke-hole.

warm.li: Dreamt the people back there were all right without me. I hope it's true.

blunt.li: Old home dream. I didn't choose this.

cheerful.li: In my dream I carried the whole old colony here on my back, and set it down next to the new one.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I'll never see the old place again. I think that one's true.

cold.li: I dreamt of the old colony's layout. This one is worse planned.
